entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cyril Lincoln Sibusiso Nyembezi (1919–2000) was a South African writer known as a Zulu novelist, poet, scholar, teacher and editor. Inkinsela yase Mgungundlovu was made into a television series because of the popularity of the novel.
